paite: Huai nung in ka etleh ngai in, Zion tang tung a Belamnou dingh ka mu a, akiang ah mipi nuaikhat singli-le-sangli, atal ua a Pa min kigelh chiatte toh adingkhawm uhi.
heading: Belamnou Leh Mipi Nuaikhat Singli-le-sangli Muhna
english: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

paite: Tui tampi leh vanpiging bang a ging van a kipan in aw ka za a; ka aw zak gosem tumte'n agosem uh atumging uh abang a;
english: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

paite: laltutphah leh thil hing lite ma leh upate ma ah la thak hileh kilawm khat asa ua; leitung a kipat a huai leikhiaksate, nuaikhat singli-le-sanglite lou ngal kuamah in huai la atheithei kei uhi.
english: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

paite: Hiaite numei lak a kihihninloute ahi ua; nungak siangthou bang ahi uhi. Hiaite apaina lamlam ua Belamnou zuite ahi uhi. Pathian a ding leh Belamnou a ding a gah masapen hi ding a mite lak a kipan a leisate ahi uhi.
english: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

paite: Huan akam uah zuau a-om kei a; amaute lah Pathian laltutphah ma ah gensiatbei ahi ngal ua.
english: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

paite: Huan angel dang van laizawl a leng ka mu a, ama'n tangtawn tanchinhoih, leitung a tengte kiang leh nam chih leh chi chih leh pau chih leh michihte kiang a genkhiak ding anei hi.
heading: Angel Thum Muhna
english: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

paite: Aw ngaihtak in, "Pathian kihta unla, amah thupina pia un; avaihawmna hun ahong tungta ngal a; van leh lei leh tuipi leh tuikhukte siampa amah bia un," achi hi.
english: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

paite: Huan angel nihna in ahon zui a, "Pukta, pukta Babulon kho thupi, nam tengteng a mingaihhatna, hehna uain dawnsaknu,” achi hi.
english: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

paite: Angel thumna in amau ahon zui a, aw ngaihtak in, "Kuapeuh gamsa leh alim bia, atal hiam akhut hiam a chiamtehna neite'n
english: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

paite: Pathian thangpaihna uain adawn ding ua, huai uain thangpaihna nou, bangmah toh hel louh hial a bawl ahi; angel siangthoute leh Belamnou muh in amah mei leh kaat in hihnat in om in teh.
english: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

paite: Huan ahihnatna meikhu uh tangtawn tangtawn in azamtou dia; huai gamsa leh alim bete leh kuapeuh amin chiamtehna nei taphot in sun leh zan in tawlngakna anei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

paite: Hiai ah misiangthou, Pathian thupiakte leh Jesu ginna zuite kuhkalna nei ding a chialna a-om hi.
english: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”

paite: Huan van a kipan aw in hichibang in, "Gelh in, tua kipan in misite, Toupa a site ahampha uh," Kha in, "Ahi, asepgimna uh akhawlsanta ding ua, athilhihte un hon zui ding ahih ziak in," achih uh ka za hi.
english: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”

paite: Huan ka etleh ngai in, meipi ngou ka mu a; huai mei tung ah mi khat Mihing Tapa toh kibang, alu a dangka-eng lallukhu khu, akhut a kawite hiamtak tawi ka mu hi.
heading: Leitung Buh Lak Hun
english: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

paite: Angel dang tempul a kipan ahong paikhia a, meipi tung a tupa kiang ah ngaihtak in, "Na kawite lik inla, at in; at hun atungta; leitung buh amingawpta," chi in akikou hi.
english: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

paite: Huai mei tung a tupa'n leitung ah akawite alik a; leitung at in a-omta hi.
english: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

paite: Huan van a om tempul a kipan in angel dang ahong paikhia a, ama'n leng kawite hiamtak atawi hi.
english: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

paite: Huan meikuang tung a thilhihtheihna nei, angel dang maitam ma a kipan in ahong paikhia a; ama'n aw ngaihtak in, huai kawite tawipa sam in, "Na kawite hiamtak lik inla, leitung a grep gahbomte lakhawm in; grepte amin mahmahta hi,” achi hi.
english: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

paite: Huai angel in leitung ah akawite alik a, leitung a grep gahte alakhawm a, Pathian thangpaihna, uain sukna thupi, uain sukna ah apailut hi.
english: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.

paite: Kho polam ah uain sukna chil in a-om a, uain sukna a kipan sakol kamkaihna tanpha louching sangkhat-le-zaguk pha in sisan aluangkhia hi.
english: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.
